sloka: यामि ज्ञात्वा कालमुपागतम् ।ततो रुद्राः सहादित्या वसवो मरुतो ऽश्वनौ ।सन्नद्धा निर्ययुस्तूर्णं राक्षसानभितः पुरात् ।। ७.२७.२२ ॥
transliteration: yāmi jñātvā kālamupāgatam ।tato rudrāḥ sahādityā vasavo maruto 'śvanau ।sannaddhā niryayustūrṇaṁ rākṣasānabhitaḥ purāt ।। 7.27.22 ॥

translations.english: Knowing that the time had come, I depart; then, the Rudras along with the Adityas, Vasus, Maruts, and the two Ashvins, arrayed for battle, quickly sallied forth from the city towards the Rakshasas.
